stage: P0 completed; no C1-C6 implementation or evaluation yet

G4.applies_to: positive masses, specifically final 8kg A/B; failure remains failure

redesign_validation.com: generate once from redesign_validation seed uniform same ranges; no official conditions

p0_derived.early_arrival_derivation: release minus maximum measured contact-to-release interval minus maximum measured first contact-to-force-loss interval
p0_derived.force_displacement_fit: rejected negative stiffness/confounded dynamic fit; no spring parameter selected
p0_derived.sustained_support_warning: probe first crossing not sustained G4; all 40 measured P0 episodes failed G4
p0_derived.bandwidth_derivation: quarter/half/full existing R1 18 rad/s below lowest measured nominal elastic sqrt(K/B)=173.205 rad/s; preregistered conservative design grid, not measured optimum
p0_derived.torque_correction_limit: componentwise 0.25*max(0,nom.tau_max - max P0 absolute torque in that architecture) cached constants; fraction is conservative design reserve, not fitted collision threshold

C1.hypothesis: planned support wrench reduces elastic motor reference and prerelease torque step
C1.feedback_signal: raw permitted-input observer bottom normal wrench, never actual/table-projected self-confirming wrench
C1.frame: full bottom world wrench including known COM gravity moment; body coadjoint / virtual-power equivalent J_world.T W_world; full inertia while held minus support, elastic lift theta=q+Kinv tau
C1.selection: G4 >=3/4 each selected architecture, min/mean/increase and peak individually checked; no peak relaxation for light cases; all safety/detector/cost gates

C2.hypothesis: normal-only impedance B/admittance A reduces contact bounce; compare identical-gain Euclidean/log-dexp variants
C2.admittance: exact 1ms ZOH second order, bounded displacement/rate derived above, freeze on alarm; return following release
C2.elastic_adaptation: desired link wrench-to-torque then same elastic motor target/inner servo, not a rigid passivity claim
C2.selection: same C1 gates; Lie variant needs >=1% improvement in G4 or TCP or p99 versus identical-gain Euclidean, otherwise geometry not adopted

C3.hypothesis: NRIC nominal-state matching or motor DOB improves mismatch tracking without hiding collision
C3.nominal_integrator: exact-ZOH or implicit midpoint elastic model, never forward Euler oscillator
C3.normalization: error scales from P0 encoder-reference normal RMS, torque scales from P0 headroom; gamma dimensionless relative feedback, no unscaled 1/gamma^2 torque added
C3.contact_gating: freeze/limit compensation around taught pickup/place/contact suspicion and on detector alarm
C3.selection: >=10% RMS or max improvement in analysis-perturbation matched development, no >5% nominal TCP/torque step regression, no lost R1 dev collision detection, no extra FA; all safety/detector/stability/timing gates

C4.hypothesis: APD/P-IDC link-reference error feedback plus elastic lift improves tracking
C4.integral: bounded and frozen at contact/alarm/clip/model switch; P-APD no integral
C4.elastic_adaptation: link law generates tau_link; theta_d=q_ref+Kinv tau_link, actual R1 motor feedback and torque sensor preserved; no rigid stability guarantee
C4.selection: >=10% RMS or max improvement vs R1 and no >5% peak/step/nominal regression; all safety/detector/stability/timing gates

C5.hypothesis: metric-compatible pRNE C.Tv removes finite-difference Mdot noise in observer
C5.selection: >=10% normal residual RMS/p99 reduction OR >=4 total extra balanced dev detections, no lost R1 detections/no extra FA; unchanged controller or separately qualified physical effects; timing gate

C6.hypothesis: earlier sustained contact/dwell avoids short bounce window observed P0
C6.conditional_trigger: P0 measured sustained support <20ms and all simple force-displacement probes fail: triggered before protocol
C6.selection: same C1 gates plus report original reference TCP cost; reject if >5% max/RMS cost even if support improves

timing.metric: paired controller+detector wall/thread CPU including allocation; guard outside measured methods

stability.plant: elastic joints + nominal rigid rotor armature + native viscosity/smooth Coulomb + actual local contact/weld where applicable; exact1ms ZOH;1cycle command delay; Drive PI current measured encoder and old command; JTS300Hz/1cycle; sampled encoder difference explicit
stability.controller_states: all output-affecting filters/integrators/previous samples, freeze phase/reference/discrete switches
stability.noise: unquantized derivative, noise/quantization disturbances not poles
stability.margins: structured scalar and worst-axis feedback gain scaling, not universal MIMO margin; pure FF margin N/A
stability.control_adoption: all tested active-mode pole radii<1+1e-6 and convergent FD; if R1 moving-point itself fails report it, do not transfer book guarantees

normal_detector_policy: Every changed control checked first on independent normal validation with frozen R1 detector. Extra FA -> reject OR one registered normal-only recalibration with new seed before any collision. No threshold tuning from collisions. C5 changed observer uses new normal targets/features ridge .02 and threshold max(3,1.2*max normal validation+.5), freeze before dev. Runtime numpy only; no official conditions in fit.

development.design: 24 stratified collisions per architecture per validation-eligible family winner, balanced signs and phases; matched no-collision references and nonofficial perturbations; failed validation candidates get no efficacy claim

redesign.condition: physical failure explanation recorded first, never from holdout/official, must use new validation seed; registered sweeps do not count as redesign

freeze.required: source/config/weights/protocol SHA256 + local commit before opening new holdout
freeze.selected_plan: one combined eligible winner; default immutable R1 fallback; no forced adoption; choose research challenger only from validation/development for transparent negative-result reporting if none eligible

holdout.com: seeded uniform x[-.028,.028],y[-.018,.018],z[-.012,.048], generate only after freeze
holdout.batch: one batch includes R1 comparator, frozen provisional R2 plus any explicitly frozen negative-result challenger; no changes after open. Identical source comparators may share one physical run with exact-hash provenance, not independently replicated evidence

official.order: LAST after freeze and new holdout, original unchanged evaluate.py
official.on_regression: reject new candidate and restore byte-identical R1 ONLY; do not promote any other new method, no retest repair
official.regression_gates: 0/4/8kg no-collision FA0 each, saturation0, no divergence; maintain R1 8kg transport15N45/43ms,10N62/56ms or disclose and reject conservative; no taught official cases for threshold selection

robustness.d4: same385/architecture grid and offsets as R1; compare baseline/v1/R1/R2; R1 historical exact-source reuse explicitly labeled possible
robustness.perturbations: same R1 physical variations plus new analysis noise seeds; not training/runtime signals
robustness.unchanged_source_reuse: only exact-hash code+conditions+deterministic physical/observable parity; never claim newly run

stop: public local staging commit; before push
